mapper.sql: id, parent_id, name, path, api, icon, type, sort, create_time
mapper.select: select from sys_menu order by sort asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu(id, parent_id, name, path, api, icon, type, sort, create_time) values (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{api}, #{icon}, #{type}, #{sort}, NOW())
